### Professional Summary

I am an analytics-focused systems builder pivoting deeper into analytics engineering and data visualization roles. My strongest work sits at the intersection of SQL Server, data modeling, operational reporting, and workflow automation, especially when the job is to turn a messy legacy process into a reliable dataset, a reusable transformation layer, or a dashboard that non-technical teams can actually use.
:::
